title: 第16章 老两口扒墙缝
novel_title: 丰腴小村妇，大佬们跪求嫁给他(锦绣钱澄)
content_zh: 徐喜弟进屋，看到张国海在给赵丁松绑。“怎么能放了他？”徐喜弟连忙上去阻止。没有刘宇宁在，想再绑赵丁，可就没这么容易了。“小丫头片子，你懂什么？！”赵丁不怀好意地上下打量徐喜弟。徐喜弟被看得头皮都有些发麻。什么意思？公婆把他给放了不说，他现在连她都敢肖想了？张国海就低着头，坐在那里不吭声。“赶紧滚，我家女儿，就是在家养一辈子，也不会嫁给你的！”范金花一脸气愤，但说出来的话却一点气势都没有。赵丁目光锁在徐喜弟身上，然后大摇大摆离开了。“不让嫁，又不报公安，就这样放走他？”徐喜弟不敢置信看着老两口。“报公安对我们有什么好处？”张国海已经四天不跟她说一句话了。此时看她，也明显带着情绪，嘟嘟囔囔，“报了公安，五里八乡都要知道这桩丑事。”“再说了，你送他去坐几年牢，他以后也还回来的，你想过后果没？”“还有他家那个混蛋儿子，能放过咱家？”“以后看好自己生的好女儿吧！”最后一句，是对范金花说的。“我生的好女儿？意思跟你一点关系都没有了？”范金花没想到，这个老头竟没有担当到这个程度。身体残缺，在外人面前唯唯诺诺，胆小怕事。在家里，倒是把责任撇得一干二净。“跟我有什么关系？从你肚子里生出来的玩意儿，怪谁？”张国海梗着脖子，一副死猪模样，是半点都不愿意承认是自己‘种’的问题。“你说什么？！”范金花嗓门又大起来。眼看两人又要干仗，徐喜弟咬咬牙，“行了，我以后盯着巴儿姐。”再让两人干仗，婆婆要是一气之下带着巴儿姐就走，把这个家撂给她，她这辈子可就全毁了。老两口齐齐看向她，回得异口同声，“以后巴儿姐，就归你管了。”得，给自己揽了个吃力不讨好的活！生怕徐喜弟后悔似的，范金花去忙煮猪食了，张国海也进了张永福的屋。被吼过一次之后，张永福还真不敢再拉裤子了。张国海进屋看了一眼，又出来，跑去后院假装自己很忙碌。……徐喜弟进火房，那一筐糯米饭和糍粑，已经被巴儿姐捧在怀里。一边吃，一边拿了一个白糍粑立在火边烤，有一边受了热隆得鼓鼓的。徐喜弟嘴角直抽抽，心想巴儿姐也不知道后没后悔，自己家里其实有好吃的，根本不用去馋赵丁那口糖！可巴儿姐并没有什么觉悟，回头鼓了她一眼，生怕她去抢那个烤到一半的糍粑似的。即便巴儿姐再不领情，徐喜弟一整个下午都盯着她。……晚饭后，徐喜弟想把人领屋里一起睡，范金花又出来阻止。“巴儿姐现在还不能跟你睡，等两天再说。”等两天？“等几天？”徐喜弟忍不住问道。范金花不让她们俩睡一个屋，证明夜里傻叔还要来。但是还要来几天，就不得而知了。该不会要一直这么办事到怀上为止吧？那可就太累了！徐喜弟一个人躺在床上，吹了油灯，然后睁着眼睛干等。一直等到她快睡着了，门才被轻轻推开。那个高大的身影来到床前，熟门熟路地脱衣上床。她像个小鸡仔一样，被他拉过去，摆弄了好一阵，选了个舒服的姿势拥着。昨夜才解锁的探知，他捉着她的手又开始了。徐喜弟一开始还觉得脸热，到最后上手左右开弓。不怪傻叔饭量大，一脸盆的饭，都吃成了一身的铁疙瘩。别说，还怪好捏的。老人常说，怕痒的汉子疼媳妇，她突发奇想，要不试他一试？想着，手已经快了一步，朝他腰上的痒痒肉捏上去。嘶~果然，他的腰身猛地一扭，飞速躲开了。估计差点没绷住，险些笑出声。但是最终还是憋住没有笑，反而一手同时握住她的双手，另一只手也恶作剧般，去找她的痒痒肉。噗呲~徐喜弟可绷不住，直接就笑出来了。他像是找到了新的乐趣，大下其手。“哎呀~”徐喜弟惊呼一声，又连忙闭嘴。她知道，公婆就在隔壁，两张床之间，就隔着一块木板墙。要不是吹了灯，还能从板墙缝隙透看。可他就忘乎所以了，所剩时间不多，他想跟她多一些欢乐的互动，留一点彼此间的念想。“唉~痒~”徐喜弟要疯了。再挠，她可真要憋不住了。于是挣扎扭打中，她两腿一跨，翻身而起骑上大马。还没坐稳，就被他双手往后一推。她愣了，还能这样？不仅这样，他有力的大手扶住她的腰前后轻推……“这……”黑暗里，徐喜弟老脸又烫得要命。傻叔可真会折腾人啊！每天换着花样，让她无力招架，甚至有些受不住。没多久，就感觉自己乏力了。原来吃一碗饭和吃五碗饭差别这么大。她双手撑着他坚实的胸膛，没一会儿，一碗饭的力气就使干净了。于是他半坐了起来。……范金花竖着两耳，脑海中甚至已经浮出了那羞人的画面。想着如果躺在隔壁屋的是自己，这辈子都没有遗憾了。一个转眼，就看到张国海正扒着墙缝，往那边看。今晚大晴，有月，或许能看见。范金花也忍不住凑上去，找了个墙缝。因为关着窗，所以透进来的月光只能隐约照见有个身影。坐在床上。晃动。也看不清是谁。没多久。一个身影又变成了两个。张国海咕咚咽了一大口，范金花在黑暗里朝他冷哼一声。没用的东西！只会对着别人咽口水。啥也不是！但范金花也看得迷糊，她怎么都想不明白。两个人都坐着，怎么办嘞？可床板又确实摇摇晃晃的。证明是那么回事。她甚至也坐起来，盘着腿，自己比划了一阵，最后抓抓头。始终想不通其中的要领。这样又不知不觉到了深夜。终于在最后闷哼中，两道身影都软躺了回去。范金花也意犹未尽地盖上被子，开始乱七八糟做梦。
content_en: Xu Xidi entered the room and saw Zhang Guohai untying Zhao Ding."How can we let him go?" Xu Xidi quickly stepped forward to stop him.Without Liu Yuning, it would not be so easy to kidnap Zhao Ding again."Little girl, what do you know?!" Zhao Ding looked Xu Xidi up and down with ill intentions.Xu Xidi's scalp was numb from the sight.What's the meaning?His parents-in-law let him go, but now he dares to even think about her?Zhang Guohai lowered his head and sat there silently."Get out now, my daughter will never marry you even if she is raised at home for the rest of her life!" Fan Jinhua looked angry, but there was no momentum at all in what she said.Zhao Ding locked his eyes on Xu Xidi, and then left in a swaggering manner."You won't let him get married, and you won't report to the police, so let him go like this?" Xu Xidi looked at the old couple in disbelief."What good does reporting to the police do to us?" Zhang Guohai had not said a word to her for four days.Looking at her at this time, she was obviously emotional and muttered, "If you report it to the police, people from all over the country will know about this scandal." "Besides, if you send him to jail for a few years, he will come back in the future. Have you thought about the consequences?" "And his bastard son, can we let our family go?" "In the future, take good care of the good daughters you give birth to!" The last sentence was addressed to Fan Jinhua."The good daughter I gave birth to? Does it mean that it has nothing to do with you?" Fan Jinhua did not expect that this old man would not take on this level of responsibility.Physically disabled, submissive in front of outsiders, timid and afraid of getting into trouble.At home, I completely ignore all responsibilities."What does it have to do with me? Who is to blame for the thing that came out of your belly?" Zhang Guohai frowned, looking like a dead pig. He was not willing to admit that he was the one who 'seded' it."What did you say?!" Fan Jinhua's voice became louder again.Seeing that the two were about to fight again, Xu Xidi gritted his teeth and said, "Okay, I will keep an eye on Sister Ba'er from now on." If the two of them were to fight again, if the mother-in-law took Sister Ba'er away in anger and left the family to her, her whole life would be ruined.The old couple looked at her together and replied in unison, "Sister Ba'er will be under your control from now on." Well, I've got a thankless job for myself!For fear that Xu Xidi would regret it, Fan Jinhua went to cook pig food, and Zhang Guohai also entered Zhang Yongfu's house.After being yelled at once, Zhang Yongfu really didn't dare to shit his pants again.Zhang Guohai went into the house to take a look, then came out and ran to the backyard to pretend that he was busy....When Xu Xidi entered the fire room, the basket of glutinous rice and glutinous rice cakes was already held in Sister Ba'er's arms.While eating, I took a white glutinous rice cake and stood it by the fire to bake. One side was swollen from the heat.The corners of Xu Xidi's mouth twitched, thinking that Sister Ba'er didn't regret it after she didn't know about it. She actually had delicious food at home, so there was no need to covet Zhao Ding's candy!But Sister Ba'er didn't have any awareness. She turned around and gave her a look, as if she was afraid that she would snatch the half-baked glutinous rice cake.Even if Sister Ba'er didn't appreciate it anymore, Xu Xidi would stare at her all afternoon....After dinner, Xu Xidi wanted to take someone inside to sleep with him, but Fan Jinhua came out to stop him."Sister Ba'er can't sleep with you now. Wait two days before we talk." Wait two days?"How many days to wait?" Xu Xidi couldn't help but ask.Fan Jinhua wouldn't let them sleep in the same room, which proved that the stupid uncle would come again at night.But how many days it will take is unknown.Shouldn't you keep doing this until you get pregnant?That would be too tiring!Xu Xidi lay on the bed alone, blew on the oil lamp, and then waited with his eyes open.It wasn't until she was about to fall asleep that the door was gently pushed open.The tall figure came to the bed, took off his clothes and went to bed in a familiar way.Like a little chicken, he pulled her over and played with her for a while before choosing a comfortable position to hold her.The exploration was unlocked last night, and he grabbed her hand and started again.Xu Xidi's face felt hot at first, but in the end he started to shoot left and right.It’s no wonder that Uncle Silly has a big appetite. He ate a basin full of rice and was covered in lumps.Don't tell me, it's so easy to pinch.The old man often said that a ticklish man loves his wife. She suddenly thought, how about giving him a try?Thinking about it, her hands took a step forward and pinched the ticklish flesh on his waist.Hiss~ Sure enough, his waist suddenly twisted and he quickly dodged.I guess I almost stopped laughing and almost laughed.But in the end, he still suppressed his laughter. Instead, he held both of her hands with one hand, and the other hand went to find her tickle like a mischief.Phew~ Xu Xidi couldn't hold back and burst out laughing.He seemed to have found a new pleasure and took advantage of it."Ouch~" Xu Xidi exclaimed and quickly shut up.She knew that her parents-in-law were next door, and there was a wooden wall between the two beds.If it hadn't been for the lamp, I could still see through the cracks in the wall.But he forgot about it. There was not much time left. He wanted to have more happy interactions with her and leave some thoughts about each other."Oh~itchy~" Xu Xidi was going crazy.If she scratches again, she really won't be able to hold it in anymore.So during the struggle, she crossed her legs, stood up and mounted the horse.Before he could sit firmly, he was pushed back by his hands.She was stunned, could she still be like this?Not only that, he held her waist with his strong hands and pushed her back and forth... "This..." In the darkness, Xu Xidi's old face was extremely hot again.Uncle Silly is really good at tormenting people!The tricks changed every day, making her unable to resist, and even a little unbearable.After a while, I felt exhausted.It turns out that there is such a big difference between eating one bowl of rice and eating five bowls of rice.She supported his solid chest with both hands, and in a short while, the strength of a bowl of rice was enough to make it clean.So he half sat up....Fan Jinhua's ears perked up, and the shameful scene even appeared in her mind.I thought that if it was me lying in the next room, I would have no regrets in this life.In the blink of an eye, Zhang Guohai was picking at the crack in the wall and looking over there.It's sunny tonight and there's a moon. Maybe we can see it.Fan Jinhua couldn't help but move forward and found a crack in the wall.Because the window was closed, the moonlight coming through could only vaguely reveal a figure.Sitting on the bed.Shake.Can't even see who it is.It didn't take long.One figure turned into two.Zhang Guohai swallowed a big mouthful, and Fan Jinhua snorted at him in the dark.Useless stuff!He only swallows saliva at others.Nothing!But Fan Jinhua was also confused. She couldn't figure it out.What should we do if both of us are sitting down?But the bed board was indeed rickety.Prove that's the case.She even sat up, crossed her legs, gestured to herself for a while, and finally scratched her head.Still can't figure out the point.It was late at night without realizing it.Finally, with a final groan, both figures lay down softly.Fan Jinhua also covered herself with a quilt and began to dream randomly.
